scripts.dev:full: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply aglow --local && wrangler dev --port 8787 --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.serve:e2e: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && wrangler d1 migrations apply aglow --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler dev --port 4173 --local-upstream localhost:4173 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --var AUTH_MODE:fake --var AUTH_SECRET:e2e-secret-not-real --var GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET:unused --var ADMIN_EMAILS:admin@example.com
scripts.deploy: node scripts/deploy-check.ts && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply aglow --remote && wrangler deploy
